# Practice Exam (Mixed MCQs & MSQs) — Topic 2: Epithelial Tissue & Cell Junctions
**Total Questions:** 10 (7 MCQs + 3 MSQs)

---

### PE_T2_01 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), simple squamous epithelium lining blood vessels is called:

- A) Mesothelium
- B) Endothelium
- C) Urothelium
- D) Epidermis

> **✅ Answer:** B) Endothelium
> **Explanation:** Endothelium lines blood and lymph vessels.

### PE_T2_02 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), simple cuboidal epithelium with microvilli brush border occurs in:

- A) Stomach mucosa
- B) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
- C) Respiratory trachea
- D) Oesophagus

> **✅ Answer:** B) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
> **Explanation:** Renal PCT features simple cuboidal brush-bordered epithelium.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 2), simple cuboi" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>


---

### PE_T2_03 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), mucus-secreting unicellular exocrine glands in stomach mucosa are called:

- A) Fibroblasts
- B) Goblet cells
- C) Mast cells
- D) Parietal cells

> **✅ Answer:** B) Goblet cells
> **Explanation:** Goblet cells are unicellular exocrine glands.

### PE_T2_04 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium is characteristically found lining the:

- A) Trachea
- B) Urinary bladder
- C) Thyroid gland
- D) Skin surface

> **✅ Answer:** A) Trachea
> **Explanation:** Trachea and bronchi are lined by pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium.

### PE_T2_05 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), non-keratinized stratified squamous epithelium lines which moist cavity?

- A) Dry skin epidermis
- B) Oral cavity and Oesophagus
- C) Thyroid follicle
- D) Renal PCT

> **✅ Answer:** B) Oral cavity and Oesophagus
> **Explanation:** Non-keratinized stratified squamous lines moist internal cavities.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 2), non-keratini" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_T2_06 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), distensible plastic urothelium featuring surface umbrella cells lines the:

- A) Stomach
- B) Urinary bladder
- C) Trachea
- D) Gall bladder

> **✅ Answer:** B) Urinary bladder
> **Explanation:** Transitional epithelium (urothelium) lines the urinary bladder.

### PE_T2_07 (MCQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2), cell junctions that seal adjacent cell membranes preventing fluid leakage are:

- A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens)
- B) Gap junctions
- C) Desmosomes
- D) Synapses

> **✅ Answer:** A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens)
> **Explanation:** Tight junctions form occluding barriers preventing fluid leakage.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 2), cell junctio" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_T2_08 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2 - MSQ), select all anatomical locations lined by Simple Cuboidal Epithelium: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Thyroid gland follicles
- [ ] B) Salivary and pancreatic ducts
- [ ] C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron
- [ ] D) Germinal surface of ovary
- [ ] E) Stomach mucosal lining

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Thyroid gland follicles, B) Salivary and pancreatic ducts, C) Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT) of nephron, D) Germinal surface of ovary
> **Explanation:** Simple cuboidal lines thyroid follicles, gland ducts, renal PCT, and ovary surface.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 2 - MSQ), select" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_T2_09 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2 - MSQ), select all cell junction types connecting adjacent epithelial cells: (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens)
- [ ] B) Adherens junctions (Zona Adherens)
- [ ] C) Desmosomes (Macula Adherens)
- [ ] D) Gap junctions (Nexus)
- [ ] E) Synaptic boutons

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Tight junctions (Zona Occludens), B) Adherens junctions (Zona Adherens), C) Desmosomes (Macula Adherens), D) Gap junctions (Nexus)
> **Explanation:** Epithelial junctions include Tight, Adherens, Desmosome, and Gap junctions.


<br/><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="In Practice Exam (Topic 2 - MSQ), select" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 8px; margin: 12px 0;" /><br/>

### PE_T2_10 (MSQ): In Practice Exam (Topic 2 - MSQ), select all characteristics of Transitional Epithelium (Urothelium): (Select all that apply)

- [ ] A) Multilayered plastic compound epithelium
- [ ] B) Surface umbrella / pear-shaped cells
- [ ] C) High stretch capability without cell separation
- [ ] D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
- [ ] E) Keratinized dead cell stratum corneum

> **✅ Answers (Multiple Select):** A) Multilayered plastic compound epithelium, B) Surface umbrella / pear-shaped cells, C) High stretch capability without cell separation, D) Lines urinary bladder, ureters, and renal pelvis
> **Explanation:** Urothelium is a distensible compound epithelium lining the urinary tract.
